name: TeamStarWolf - United States-Attributed Threat Actors Case Study
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping and not an attribution claim: ATT&CK attributes none of these objects to any country. The 85 Enterprise techniques ATT&CK v20.0 records for the six objects discussed in case-studies/THREAT_ACTORS_UNITED_STATES.md (G0020 Equation, S0019 Regin, S0038 Duqu, S0143 Flame, S0603 Stuxnet, S0690 Green Lambert), from data/attack/group_to_technique.jsonl and software_to_technique.jsonl, plus one technique (T1195) inferred by the study from the interdiction reporting. Score is the number of the six objects the technique is recorded for (1 to 3); 0 marks the study's inference. Comments name the objects and the study's source numbers.
